The project leverages LNG regasification cold energy to reduce energy consumption and emissions while expanding APD's production capabilities in the region.

The plan would combine Brookfield Infrastructure Partners L.P. (BIP) and BIPC into a single publicly traded corporation called Brookfield Infrastructure Partners Inc. (BIP Inc.). CCB.title: Attention Long-Term Shareholders of Aardvark Therapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ: AARD); Coastal Financial Corporation (NASDAQ: CCB); Erasca, Inc. (NASDAQ: ERAS); and New Era Energy & Digital, Inc. (NASDAQ: NUAI): Grabar Law Office is Investigating Claims on Your Behalf
CCB.summary: Grabar Law Office is investigating securities fraud and fiduciary duty breach claims against four companies: Aardvark Therapeutics for allegedly misrepresenting the safety profile of its drug candidate ARD-101 before a clinical hold was placed; Coastal Financial Corporation for failing to disclose deterioration in its CCBX partner loan portfolio and credit losses; Erasca, Inc. for making misleading statements about its ERAS-0015 therapy and improper comparisons to competitors; and New Era Energy & Digital for overstating progress on its data center project and allegedly engaging in fraudulent oil-and-gas schemes.

GOOG.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed a class action lawsuit against Alphabet Inc. on behalf of investors who purchased securities between May 19, 2026 and July 16, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that Alphabet made materially false and misleading statements regarding the Gemini 3.5 Pro, claiming it delivered disappointing training results and would face significant launch delays. Investors who purchased during this period may be eligible for compensation. The deadline to serve as lead plaintiff is December 1, 2026.

GOOG.title: Fastly: Riding the Agentic AI Wave
GOOG.summary: Fastly, an edge cloud platform company, is well-positioned to capitalize on the emerging agentic AI wave. Unlike traditional LLMs, autonomous AI agents require low-latency execution and continuous querying, which Fastly's edge infrastructure and security tools are optimized to provide. The company shows strong earnings growth with consensus estimates of 71.43% quarterly growth and 307.69% for full-year 2026, while consistently beating analyst expectations. Evidence suggests Meta's popular Muse platform may be leveraging Fastly's technology.

GOOG.title: Buy Cisco Systems as Leader of the AI Cloud Networking Space for 2027
GOOG.summary: Cisco Systems closed fiscal 2026 with $9.3 billion in hyperscaler AI infrastructure orders, a 4.5x increase from fiscal 2025. The company expects hyperscaler AI revenues to reach $7.5 billion in fiscal 2027, up from $4 billion. Networking product orders rose 40% year-over-year in Q4 fiscal 2026, marking the eighth consecutive quarter of double-digit growth. Security revenues increased 14% year-over-year, with firewall orders growing over 30% for the second consecutive quarter. Cisco projects fiscal 2027 revenues of $72.2-$73.4 billion with non-GAAP earnings of $5.05-$5.11 per share.

JNJ.title: HALO Wins Court Order Blocking Merck's Keytruda SC in Europe
JNJ.summary: A Dutch patent court ruled that Merck's Keytruda subcutaneous formulation infringes Halozyme's MDASE patent, ordering Merck to cease manufacturing and sales across eight European markets. The ruling does not affect Keytruda's intravenous version. This marks another legal victory for Halozyme against Merck, though the company clarified that its separate ENHANZE technology and licensing business remain unaffected.

JNJ.title: Bayer Seeks Kerendia Label Expansion in Non-Diabetic CKD
JNJ.summary: Bayer announced FDA acceptance of a supplemental new drug application for Kerendia (finerenone) to treat chronic kidney disease in non-diabetic patients. The approval is based on positive phase III FIND-CKD trial data showing the drug significantly delayed kidney disease progression and reduced cardiovascular-kidney events. This expansion broadens Kerendia's addressable market and strengthens Bayer's cardiovascular and renal portfolio, with the drug already approved for diabetic CKD and heart failure in multiple markets.

An unauthorized third party accessed limited customer account information including names, addresses, phone numbers, email addresses, and partial Social Security numbers. The law firm is offering free case evaluations to affected customers.

SOJC.title: Should You Invest in the Fidelity MSCI Utilities Index ETF (FUTY)?
SOJC.summary: The Fidelity MSCI Utilities Index ETF (FUTY) is a low-cost passively managed fund with a 0.08% expense ratio and $2.18 billion in assets. However, it has received a Zacks ETF Rank of 4 (Sell) and is not recommended for investors seeking utilities exposure. The fund has underperformed year-to-date, declining 1.81%, with better alternatives available such as Vanguard Utilities Index Fund ETF Shares (VPU) and State Street Utilities Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLU).

FLNC.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges Fluence Energy, Inc Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
FLNC.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Fluence Energy, Inc. alleging that the company made materially false statements regarding its ability to deliver backlog and meet fiscal 2026 guidance. The complaint claims production problems at manufacturing facilities were not adequately remediated, and a material portion of backlog would not be delivered as promised. Investors who purchased securities between November 24, 2025 and September 16, 2026 may be eligible to join the case.

FLNC.title: ROSEN, A LEADING LAW FIRM, Encourages Fluence Energy, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action – FLNC
FLNC.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed a class action lawsuit on behalf of Fluence Energy, Inc. (NASDAQ: FLNC) investors who purchased securities between November 24, 2025 and September 16, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that defendants made materially false and misleading statements regarding the company's ability to deliver its backlog and meet fiscal 2026 revenue guidance, citing incomplete manufacturing facilities and unresolved production problems. Investors who purchased during the class period may be entitled to compensation. The deadline to serve as lead plaintiff is November 30, 2026.

FLNC.title: ROSEN, TRUSTED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Qfin Holdings, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - QFIN
FLNC.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed securities class action lawsuits against Qfin Holdings, FuelCell Energy, and Fluence Energy on behalf of investors who purchased securities during specified periods. The lawsuits allege that defendants made false or misleading statements regarding business resilience, financial results, and the impact of regulatory changes. Investors have until November 30, 2026 to move the court to serve as lead plaintiff.

FLNC.title: ROSEN, THE FIRST FILING FIRM, Encourages Tigo Energy, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action First Filed by the Firm - TYGO
FLNC.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed securities class action lawsuits against Tigo Energy, FuelCell Energy, and Fluence Energy, alleging that defendants made materially false and misleading statements regarding business projections and financial prospects. FLNC.title: FTK IMPORTANT DEADLINE: ROSEN, TRUSTED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Flotek Industries, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - FTK
FLNC.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed securities class action lawsuits against Flotek Industries, FuelCell Energy, and Fluence Energy. Investors who purchased securities during specified class periods are encouraged to secure counsel before upcoming lead plaintiff deadlines.

FLNC.title: ROSEN, SKILLED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Lincoln Educational Services Corporation Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - LINC

FNMA.title: How a HELOC on Your Current Home Affects a Sarasota County Second-Home Mortgage
FNMA.summary: BestRate Mortgage, a mortgage brokerage operating across 12 states, has published guidance on how out-of-state homeowners can use home equity loans or HELOCs on their existing residences to fund down payments on second homes in Sarasota County without refinancing their primary mortgages. The new equity payment is counted as debt during underwriting of the Florida mortgage.

OGG.title: Osisko Gold Closes Previously Announced US$30 million Strategic Equity Investment by Trafigura
OGG.summary: Osisko Gold Group Inc. announced the closing of a US$30 million equity investment from Urion Investments Holdings Limited (affiliated with Trafigura), issuing 9.55 million common shares at US$3.14 per share. Urion will hold approximately 3.0% of the company and has entered into a voting support agreement. The company plans to use proceeds for development of its Cariboo Gold Project in British Columbia, with negotiations ongoing for an additional US$120 million prepayment facility.

SPCX.title: SPCX to Acquire 800 MHz Spectrum for Superior Network: Buy the Stock?
SPCX.summary: SpaceX has agreed to acquire Grain Management's 800 MHz spectrum portfolio to enhance Starlink Mobile's connectivity capabilities. The low-band spectrum will enable a hybrid satellite-terrestrial network, improving indoor coverage and reliability. Combined with previously acquired 2 GHz spectrum from EchoStar, this positions SpaceX to compete as a major U.S. wireless operator while expanding its AI infrastructure ambitions.

SPCX.title: ETFs to Benefit as Nasdaq's Breakthrough Still Matters
SPCX.summary: The Nasdaq Composite reached a record high, rising 1.05% on October 5 and 0.45% on October 6 to close at 27,599.79, driven by strong performance in AI and technology stocks. Despite elevated Treasury yields at 5.34%, investors remain focused on AI infrastructure demand and earnings growth. Major contributors included Tesla, SpaceX, Meta, Microsoft, Marvell Technology, AMD, Broadcom, and Nvidia, which reached a $6 trillion market cap. Lower oil prices also provided relief to equity investors.

DAL.title: DAL Q3 Earnings Miss Estimates as Higher Fuel Costs Hurt Margins
DAL.summary: Delta Air Lines reported Q3 2026 earnings of $1.72 per share, missing estimates by 4.44% as fuel costs surged 62%. DAL.summary: Pre-market futures opened higher following Thursday's mixed close, with bond yields down from 24-year highs and oil prices moderating despite Middle East tensions. UAL.title: FTAI and United Airlines Expand Engine Exchange Program to CFM56-7B
UAL.summary: FTAI Aviation announced a multi-year Maintenance, Repair and Exchange (MRE) agreement with United Airlines, expanding an existing V2500 engine exchange program to include CFM56-7B engines. Under the program, FTAI delivers serviceable engines ahead of United's scheduled removals and purchases the unserviceable engines, eliminating traditional shop visits and reducing maintenance costs and downtime for United's Boeing 737 NG fleet.

NTAP.title: Everpure Stock Surges 147% in Six Months: Is It Still a Buy?
NTAP.summary: Everpure shares have surged 147% over six months, driven by strong enterprise demand, growing subscription revenues, and AI/hyperscale opportunities. While fundamentals remain solid with 38% revenue growth and expanding recurring revenues, investors are advised to hold rather than buy at current levels due to valuation concerns, cost pressures, and negative free cash flow.

NTAP.summary: Earnings season is a critical period for investors as it provides essential financial information about companies, impacts stock prices, and offers insights into overall market sentiment and economic health. ALDX.title: argenx Meets Primary Endpoint in Phase II Celiac Disease Study
ALDX.summary: argenx announced positive phase II results for FB102, an investigational therapy for celiac disease, meeting its primary endpoint with significant improvements in intestinal tissue measures versus placebo and no new safety signals. The company plans to advance FB102 into late-stage development and evaluate it for other autoimmune conditions. However, the stock declined nearly 12% following a separate announcement that argenx discontinued its phase III UNITY study for Vyvgart Hytrulo in Sjögren's disease.

ALDX.title: EDIT Set to Begin First-in-Human Study in Hypercholesterolemia
ALDX.summary: Editas Medicine announced approval to initiate the Strive phase I/II clinical study of EDIT-401, an investigational in vivo gene-editing therapy for heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HeFH) in Australia. The single-dose therapy demonstrated approximately 90% or greater reductions in atherogenic lipoproteins in preclinical primate studies. Patient dosing is planned for 2026 with initial safety data expected in Q1 2027.

ALDX.title: Ultragenyx to Sell Rare Pediatric Disease PRV for $210M to Boost Cash
ALDX.summary: Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical has entered into a definitive agreement to sell a Rare Pediatric Disease Priority Review Voucher (PRV) for $210 million following FDA approval of its gene therapy Genglycos. After a $42 million NIH payment obligation, approximately $168 million in non-dilutive capital will support the company's research, development, and commercialization efforts, helping it move toward profitability without equity financing.

ALDX.title: Here's Why You Should Add LPCN Stock to Your Portfolio Now
ALDX.summary: Lipocine (LPCN) is an emerging specialty pharmaceutical company with an approved oral testosterone replacement therapy (Tlando) generating royalties and expanding internationally. The company's key near-term catalyst is Brlizio (LPCN 1154), an oral brexanolone treatment for postpartum depression entering phase III BLOOM study in late 2026. LPCN carries a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) with a broader pipeline targeting depression, obesity, epilepsy, and liver cirrhosis.

CSCO.title: Navigating the AI Boom: Bubble is NOT a Four-Letter Word
CSCO.summary: The article argues that while AI is being labeled a bubble by prominent investors like Ray Dalio and Michael Burry, five key data points suggest the market may be entering its explosive growth phase rather than nearing a peak. Current valuations remain reasonable compared to the dot-com era, retail sentiment is bearish (historically bullish for markets), and IPO activity is lower than during previous manias, suggesting the AI boom has significant room to run.

CSCO.title: Buy Cisco Systems as Leader of the AI Cloud Networking Space for 2027
CSCO.summary: Cisco Systems closed fiscal 2026 with $9.3 billion in hyperscaler AI infrastructure orders, a 4.5x increase from fiscal 2025. The company expects hyperscaler AI revenues to reach $7.5 billion in fiscal 2027, up from $4 billion. Networking product orders rose 40% year-over-year in Q4 fiscal 2026, marking the eighth consecutive quarter of double-digit growth. Security revenues increased 14% year-over-year, with firewall orders growing over 30% for the second consecutive quarter. Cisco projects fiscal 2027 revenues of $72.2-$73.4 billion with non-GAAP earnings of $5.05-$5.11 per share.

CSCO.title: Cisco Systems (CSCO) Sees a More Significant Dip Than Broader Market: Some Facts to Know

CSCO.title: Arista Stock Rises 64.7% YTD: Is There More Upside Ahead?
CSCO.summary: Arista Networks has gained 64.7% year-to-date, driven by strong demand for AI networking and Ethernet infrastructure. The company's Etherlink AI-fabric customer base surpassed 100, with Scale-Across opportunity projected to reach $15-20B by 2030. However, heavy customer concentration, rising inventory levels ($2.5B), and declining gross margins (63.4% vs 65.6% prior year) pose significant risks. With a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold), the stock appears overvalued relative to industry peers.

CSCO.title: Can Arista's New Rack-Scale Ethernet Solutions for AI Stoke Growth?
CSCO.summary: Arista Networks launched new open Ethernet rack-scale solutions designed for high-density AI infrastructure, supporting up to 144 accelerators per rack and 1,024 XPUs across racks. The platform features advanced cooling and optics that can boost networking capacity to 6.5 Pb/s per rack. Developed collaboratively with AMD, Arm, Broadcom, Meta, Microsoft, and Qualcomm, the solutions aim to provide flexible alternatives to proprietary AI systems while strengthening Arista's position in AI networking.

EDIT.title: EDIT Set to Begin First-in-Human Study in Hypercholesterolemia
EDIT.summary: Editas Medicine announced approval to initiate the Strive phase I/II clinical study of EDIT-401, an investigational in vivo gene-editing therapy for heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HeFH) in Australia. The single-dose therapy demonstrated approximately 90% or greater reductions in atherogenic lipoproteins in preclinical primate studies. Patient dosing is planned for 2026 with initial safety data expected in Q1 2027.

PPG.title: PPG Invests $70 Million to Expand Aerospace Operations in Huntsville

The investment is driven by rising demand for aircraft cockpit and passenger windows across commercial, military, and general aviation markets.

PPG.title: Will PPG Industries' Strong Cash Flow Fuel Shareholder Returns?

MUX.title: McEwen Signs US$55 Million Agreement to Sell Fuller and Paymaster
MUX.summary: McEwen Inc. has agreed to sell its Fuller and Paymaster properties in Timmins, Ontario to Discovery Mining's subsidiary Dome Mine Ltd. for US$55 million (US$5M cash, US$50M in Discovery shares). KRTL.title: KRTL International Explores U.S.-Bolivia Critical Minerals Pathways Following Mining Cooperative LOI and Development Framework
KRTL.summary: KRTL Holding Group Inc. announced that its subsidiary KRTL International Corp. has executed a Letter of Intent with a Bolivia-based mining cooperative to evaluate mineral opportunities, particularly antimony and tungsten. The company is gathering historical assay data and technical documentation through KRTL BlueSpot to assess the project, leveraging its established Bolivia network and U.S.-facing platform amid growing U.S. focus on critical mineral supply chains.

The investment reflects strong market fundamentals in the crude tanker sector, supported by record VLCC earnings and structural tightening driven by geopolitical disruption and longer shipping routes.

MLYS.title: Mineralys Therapeutics Presents New Data for Lorundrostat at the American Heart Association Hypertension Scientific Sessions 2026
MLYS.summary: Mineralys Therapeutics presented new clinical trial data for lorundrostat, its investigational aldosterone synthase inhibitor for treating difficult-to-treat hypertension. The Launch-HTN trial showed 46% of participants achieved AHA/ACC guideline systolic blood pressure targets (<130 mmHg) at 12 weeks, with over two-thirds achieving ≥10 mmHg reduction. The Explore-OSA trial demonstrated clinically meaningful morning blood pressure reductions in obstructive sleep apnea patients with no adverse effects on sleep apnea indices.

AIFA.title: AIFA Continues to Enhance aifa.one With AI Agents and Launches Creator Program Across Key AI Sectors
AIFA.summary: All In FutureTech Alliance Inc. (NASDAQ: AIFA) announced the expansion of its aifa.one platform with an AI-driven creator ecosystem. The company is launching an invitation-only creator onboarding program in December 2026, offering participating creators content-production fees and revenue-sharing opportunities. AIFA aims to reduce creator dependence on third-party platform algorithms by providing a durable content platform. A companion mobile application is planned for Q4 2026.

VIVK.title: Vivakor Signs LOI for Proposed $40 Million Acquisition of Direct Midstream
VIVK.summary: Vivakor, Inc. announced a non-binding Letter of Intent to acquire 100% of Direct Midstream, LLC for a gross purchase price of $40 million, valued at 4x Direct Midstream's targeted 2027 free cash flow of $10 million. The deal includes a $10 million capital investment by Vivakor and consideration of approximately $29 million in Series B Preferred Stock and $1 million in common stock. The acquisition aims to expand Vivakor's Permian Basin infrastructure and add produced water and oilfield waste management capabilities.

PGY.title: Will PGY's Expanding Funding Base Reduce Its Reliance on ABS Markets?
PGY.summary: Pagaya Technologies raised $3.7 billion across six asset-backed securities (ABS) transactions in Q2 2026 and added 11 new institutional investors, bringing the total to 174. The company is diversifying its funding model beyond traditional securitization through auto funding facilities, variable funding notes, and revolving personal-loan facilities. Despite expanding alternative funding sources, Pagaya completed a $600 million personal-loan securitization, bringing 2026 ABS issuance to over $9 billion, demonstrating that securitization remains a core funding engine.
